name: Kodak Tri-X 400
notes: B&W single-layer path. H&D approx from Kodak Tri-X 400 (400TX) datasheet characteristic curve for D-76 / recommended processing; straight-line gamma ≈ 0.65 (typical pictorial aim; Tri-X can be developed steeper). logE = 0 at ISO speed point (D ≈ 0.10–0.15 above fog per Kodak B&W speed method — using 0.15 for engine consistency with color stocks). spectral_crosstalk is a 1×3 panchromatic weight row (not 3×3), reasoned from Tri-X panchromatic sensitivity (strong green, solid red, useful blue). dir_coupler is identity 1×1 (no color DIR). Diffuse RMS Granularity 17 from Kodak Tri-X datasheet. Mild halation (B&W AH layer; no red dye glow — green_fraction 0). Print paper = grade ~2–3 silver-gelatin enlarging paper, gamma ≈ 2.1. Memory approximation. | grain keys flattened so engine reads datasheet RMS (no local Tri-X scans) 2026-07-10
